metadata.name: HandArt
metadata.description: Animated (flicker) ASCII art in the Hex Dump style, made with the 21st ASCII editor and baked to a looping video. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and retro terminal-style backgrounds.
metadata.author: camilleia.pelisson
